narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to southeastern Pennsylvania on the afternoon of June 23. Rainfall totals were as high as 1 to 2 inches.
ev: An access ramp from Interstate 476 to West MacDade Boulevard in Woodlyn was closed due to flooding near Crum Creek.
Minor flooding occurred along Pennypack Creek in Northeast Philadelphia.
lsr: Lane closure on I-95 near Exit 4 at the Commodore Barry Bridge with standing water seen on the shoulder and getting into the right traffic lane.
Pennypack Creek rose into minor flood with a four foot rise in an hour.
PENNDOT reports 2 lanes closed on I-95 S near the Betsy Ross Bridge and Aramingo Avenue.
Flooding on I-95 southbound at Exit: MacDade Blvd. There is a ramp closure.
Flooding on I-76 westbound between Exit 342 US 13 and US 30 West and Exit 341 Montgomery Dr and River Dr. There is a lane restriction.
